name: player_pff_pass_plays and player_pff_routes emit distinct non-blank cells under their own payload keys (executed-result parity)
description: Seed one player with a PFF 2023 seasonlog carrying pass_plays=612 and routes=451, then request both column ids. The executed result must carry pff_pass_plays_0=612 and pff_routes_0=451 -- the payload keys the frontend fields read (player_value_path pff_pass_plays / pff_routes). A blank cell is the failure this pins: the server aliases the result column as the physical column name, so a select_as that drifts from the field's player_value_path renders an empty cell for a value the API returned correctly. The two values are deliberately different so a repoint of either id at the other's column is red rather than silently equal.
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "ta90cad343257940bfecf8a1ded1f3615"."pass_plays" AS "pff_pass_plays_0", "ta90cad343257940bfecf8a1ded1f3615"."routes" AS "pff_routes_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "pff_player_seasonlogs" as "ta90cad343257940bfecf8a1ded1f3615" on "ta90cad343257940bfecf8a1ded1f3615"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "ta90cad343257940bfecf8a1ded1f3615"."season_year" = 2023 and "ta90cad343257940bfecf8a1ded1f3615"."season_type" = 'REGPO' where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "ta90cad343257940bfecf8a1ded1f3615"."pass_plays", "ta90cad343257940bfecf8a1ded1f3615"."routes", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
